topics.label: Welcome and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines the key concepts and learning objectives regarding cancer evolution and microenvironmental interactions.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how Darwinian natural selection operates through the progressive accumulation of driver mutations and epigenetic alterations that confer competitive growth advantages to cellular clones.

topics.label: Stem Cell Hierarchies and the Cell of Origin
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how normal tissue hierarchies, cancer stem cell properties, and the cell of origin influence tumor initiation and hierarchical progression.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Promotion of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental stimuli and chronic inflammation act as essential promotional cues that induce stem-like states and drive malignant transformation in mutated tissues.

topics.label: Established Tumor Microenvironments, Spatial Profiling, and Coevolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the dependence of established tumors on supportive stromal interactions, the spatial and single-cell profiling techniques used to analyze them, and an overall synthesis of multi-factorial cancer coevolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session and previews the subsequent lecture on cancer therapies.
